text:
NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>Across the source collage, I see a lower café volume, an attached sloped glazed wing, a tall timber-framed glazed A-frame, a raised terrace with a projecting fascia, an exterior stair, open ground-floor seating bays, and a separately projected canopy over part of the upper terrace. The side view also shows a warm timber-clad wall, and the interior view shows the glazed gable and exposed roof framing. The current model has the lower wing, A-frame, terrace fascia, stair, and front-right open bay with supports. Its upper terrace shows umbrellas but no separate projecting canopy and supports; the fascia below is not a substitute. The current side wall also reads as a mostly smooth peach surface rather than the source’s jointed timber panels.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="roof">problem: The source’s high-angle panel shows a separate canopy projecting over part of the upper terrace, supported above the terrace seating. The current roof and upper-level close-ups show umbrellas but no such canopy; the lower terrace fascia is present but serves a different location and role.
action: Add the separate upper-terrace canopy and its supports at the source location while retaining the existing terrace slab and fascia.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="right">problem: The source side view has a warm timber-clad wall with visible vertical panel joints and relief. The current side wall is nearly smooth, with only sparse seams.
action: Add readable vertical timber panel joints and shallow board relief to the existing wall, keeping its current volume.</issue>
<keep>Attached sloped glazed wing at the front-left.</keep>
<keep>Open front-right ground-floor seating bay and its support columns.</keep>
